title: Validation Proof
description: Use when validation quality matters. Covers proof from the real requested user/tooling path and exact real paths for files, routes, services, commands, or artifacts.

requirements.statement: Validation must prove the actual user/tooling path requested by the operator, not only a stubbed route, isolated unit, mocked API, or synthetic shortcut.
Any file, route, service, command, or artifact path used as proof must be the real path exercised by the assigned workflow, not an inferred, stale, placeholder, or adjacent path.
